en:
## Bug Fixes

- Ensure reasoning and text content are persisted and broadcast before any tool executes; a failed checkpoint now blocks subsequent tools instead of silently losing output
- Support revision-based merging for content checkpoints, including delayed reasoning metadata patches and ordered provider replay across Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini/Codex/NUG
- Project checkpoint continuation back into the real message so streaming reasoning uses incremental parsing and measurement instead of full re-parse per frame
- Refactor the narrator toolbar controller to a shared panel-level instance with three-zone layout (header/menu/bottom); fix empty-header drag-back and skeleton-to-header ResizeObserver registration
- Stabilize workspace write recovery with precise scope leases and atomic recovery evidence, preventing tool result loss after interruptions
- Auto-detect frontend/backend version mismatches and preserve retry after refresh cancellation; keep request recovery session affinity and fix Bash default serial/streaming barrier behavior

## Performance

- Replace the old flush-based content path with OutputContentAccumulator to avoid redundant persistence and broadcast work during streaming
zh-CN:
## 修复

- reasoning/text 内容 checkpoint 在工具执行前强制落库并广播；checkpoint 失败时阻止后续工具执行，避免静默丢失输出
- 支持按 revision 合并内容 checkpoint，包括 reasoning 元数据延迟补丁和 Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini/Codex/NUG 各 provider 的 orderedContent 回放
- checkpoint 续流投射回真实消息，同 ID reasoning 增量流走增量解析与测量路径，不再每帧全量重解析
- 叙述者工具栏控制器重构为面板层共享实例，新增 header/menu/bottom 三段分区；修复清空标题栏后无法拖回工具及骨架屏结束后容量观察器未注册
- 稳定工作区写入恢复：精确范围租约与原子恢复证据，避免中断后丢失工具结果和编辑器重试失败
- 自动检测前后端版本差异并保留刷新取消后的重试能力；保持请求恢复会话缓存亲和性，修复 Bash 默认串行与流式屏障行为

## 性能优化

- 流式内容持久化改用 OutputContentAccumulator，减少流式过程中的冗余落库与广播
